paths.name: Manuel Carlés / Liga Patriótica
paths.notes: Following a bloody struggle, Carlés captures Rosario and assumes the presidency after a rousing speech for his followers in Buenos Aires. Promising vast territorial expansion and an end to the Red Terror that plagues Patagonia, the nationalist rhetoric drummed up by him and his Liga Patriótica Argentina, or Patriotic League of Argentina, is met with a wave of enthusiasm by the struggling people of his country.

paths.name: Regionalists
paths.notes:
Lu Yuguang and the old Regionalist order take power, turning Liangguang's attention generally inwards.
Leading the Jiuguixi - Shaozhuang Pai, or Old Guangxi Clique - Young Guangxi Faction, he has to contend with Shen Hongying, his father's old rival within the Old Guangxi Clique, as well as Chen Lianbo and his Guangzhou Merchant Government.

paths.name: Federalists
paths.notes:
Chen Jiongming's Federalist coalition takes power thanks to the might of the Yue Army.
He secures the loyalty of various republicans, intellectuals, and gentrymen, under the banner of the Gonghe Datongmeng - Yue Jun Siling Bu, or Grand Republican Alliance - Yue Army Clique, on his quest to unite China under a Federal system.

paths.name: Kuomintang
paths.notes: A junta of the Zhongguo Guomindang Xinyuexi, or New Guangdong Clique of the Kuomintang, takes power under the initial leadership of Chen Jitang. Tensions between left and right, Guangdong and Guangxi have to be resolved from there, before they can commence their long-awaited Northern Expedition.

paths.name: Mackenzie King / Liberals
paths.notes:
The Liberal Party of Canada, led by Mackenzie King, win the 1936 Canadian elections, pass Bill 7, and maintain their hold on power.
After the Weltkrieg, King retires and the more progressive tendency within the Liberal Party of Canada come to prominence and retain power in the post-war elections.
objectives: Follow the Liberals political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Robert Manion / Conservatives
paths.notes: The Conservative Party of Canada, led by Robert Manion, win the 1936 Canadian elections, ensuring the dominance of the moderate Tories within the Party, and the maintenance of a deft hand when tensions in Québec escalate.
objectives: Follow the Conservatives political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Unionists
paths.notes:
In a great parliamentary upset, Bill 7 is not passed, leading to the collapse of the government and another election. The Conservatives, under their new leader RB Bennet, are victorious.
In a response to the crisis in Québec, Bennet is ousted as prime minister. His successor restores the Unionist Party of Canada, eventually forming a broad coalition between hardliners, moderates and liberal-unionists within the party.
After the war, civilian rule is reinstated under the Conservatives.
objectives: Follow the Unionists political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Exiles
paths.notes:
In a great parliamentary upset, Bill 7 is not passed, leading to the collapse of the government and another election. The Conservatives, under their new leader RB Bennet, are victorious.
In a response to the crisis in Québec, Bennet is ousted as prime minister. His successor restores the Unionist Party, leading to the eventual empowerment of the British Government-in-Exile.
After the war, civilian rule is reinstated under the Conservatives.
objectives: Follow the Exiles political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: CCF
paths.notes:
The Liberals win the 1936 Canadian elections, pass Bill 7, and maintain their hold on power.
After the Weltkrieg, and the resignation of party leader JS Woodsworth, the Co-Operative Commonwealth Federation comes to power. The Farmer-Labour wing of the party leads a coalition between the CCF and the Liberals.

Requires:
The Union of Britain falls and the United Kingdom is restored
objectives: Follow the CCF political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Social Credit
paths.notes:
In a great parliamentary upset, Bill 7 is not passed, leading to the collapse of the government and another election. The Conservatives, under their new leader RB Bennet, are victorious.
In a response to the crisis in Québec, Bennet is ousted as prime minister. His successor's actions lead to the eventual empowerment of the British Government-in-Exile, alienating the populace to their supposed allies.
After the war and the declaration of a Republic, the Social Credit Party of Canada comes to power, forming a coalition with the Conservatives.

Requires:

objectives: Follow the Social Credit political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.notes:

In order to move away from the centralist tendencies of London, Birmingham is chosen as the new capital of Britain after the Second Weltkrieg, with Scotland and Wales being granted a large degree of autonomy.

paths.name: Federationists - Attlee

paths.name: Federationists - Pankhurst

paths.name: Federationists - Wilkinson

After the Second Weltkrieg, y Glais fully dissolves the National Trade Union Congress of the Union of Britain, and forms a new English TUC, granting full independence to the new Scottish and Welsh TUCs. Ebenezer Edwards takes over as Chairman of the Union of England.
objectives: Follow the Autonomists - Independence political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Maximists - Strachey
paths.notes:

paths.name: Actionists

objectives: Follow the Actionists political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: No Majority

objectives: Follow the No Majority political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Kabinett Schleicher - Moderate
paths.notes:
Kurt von Schleicher is appointed Reichskanzler when Germany's elections following Black Monday produce no majority in the Reichstag.
Later, an attempt at a socialist revolution leads him to pass the Enabling Act, securing the power of his Kabinett Schleicher, or Schleicher Cabinet, allowing him to attempt to transform Germany in line with his centralising and militaristic image.
After victory in the Second Weltkrieg, his successor continues the legacy of the more moderate Deutschnationale Einheitsfront, or German National Unity Front, that rules the New State which Schleicher establishes, with the regime set to rule Germany for decades to come.

objectives: Follow the PSR-Right - Fondaminsky political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

objectives: Follow the PSR-Left (Spiridonovist) - Zdobnov political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.notes:
The Liberal Entente, led by Mehmed Sabahaddin Beyoğlu and the Hürriyet ve İtilaf Fırkası, or Freedom and Accord Party, take over from Mustafa Kemal.

paths.name: Democratic Party
paths.notes:
The Liberal Entente, led by Mehmed Sabahaddin Beyoğlu and the HİF, take over from Mustafa Kemal.

paths.name: National Conservative Party
paths.notes:
The Liberal Entente, led by Mehmed Sabahaddin Beyoğlu and the HİF, take over from Mustafa Kemal.
They work towards the implementation of their programme of decentralisation and autonomy.
Following an escalation of protests sparked by secularisation, and the increased influence of ethnic minorities in the empire, Grand Vizier Sabahaddin is replaced by the conservative Shakib Arslan and the Milli Muhafazakâr Fırkası, or National Conservative Party, in an attempt to save the liberal ruling coalition. He laters fall to a military coup.

paths.name: Military Government
paths.notes:
Field Marshal Mustafa Fevzi Çakmak seizes power in the wake of the assassination of Grand Vizier Mustafa Kemal.

paths.name: Endeavour Front (Statist)
paths.notes:
Field Marshal Mustafa Fevzi Çakmak seizes power in the wake of the assassination of Grand Vizier Mustafa Kemal.
He relinquishes power, and facilitates elections that result in Mustafa İsmet Reşit being made Grand Vizier, and the winners being a broad coalition known as the Çalışma Cephesi, or Endeavour Front, which leads the empire towards a state-led centralist economy.

paths.name: Endeavour Front (Liberal)
paths.notes:
Field Marshal Mustafa Fevzi Çakmak seizes power in the wake of the assassination of Grand Vizier Mustafa Kemal.
He relinquishes power, and facilitates elections that result in Mustafa İsmet Reşit being made Grand Vizier, and the winners being a broad coalition known as the Çalışma Cephesi. After later replacing the Grand Vizier with Musa Kâzım Karabekir, the Çalışma Cephesi, or Endeavour Front, leads the empire towards economic liberalisation and the privatisation of state monopolies.

paths.name: Ottoman People's Party (Kadroist)
paths.notes:
Field Marshal Mustafa Fevzi Çakmak seizes power in the wake of the assassination of Grand Vizier Mustafa Kemal. He relinquishes power, and facilitates elections that result in Mustafa İsmet Reşit being made Grand Vizier, and the winners being a broad coalition known as the Endeavour Front.
Inspired by the "Kadro" paper, and of developments elsewhere, OHF extremists from within the Front take control of the party, and transform the Ottoman Empire into a totalitarian one-party-state led by the Kadroist faction of the Osmanlı Halk Fırkası, or Ottoman People's Party.
This is not without its consequences...

This is followed by the abdication of the King and the formation of Second Polish Republic, led by Maksymilian Malinowski's PSL, in coalition with the PPS.
The new Republic rejoins the Reichspakt, becoming a German Oststaat once again, though this time without a King.
objectives: Follow the Republic - PSL (Reichspakt) political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Republic - Chjena (Reichspakt)
paths.notes:
The Centrolew, or Centre-Left, alliance of the PPS and PSL win the election on a joint ticket, and form a left-liberal government. However, they are promptly deposed by the King, who installs a pro-German government that is soon overthrown by mass protests.
This is followed by the abdication of the King and the formation of Second Polish Republic, which rejoins the Reichspakt, becoming a German Oststaat once again, though this time without a King.
Following a liberalisation controversy, the government is couped by members of the army aligned with the Chjena, and Władysław Grabski is installed as President.
objectives: Follow the Republic - Chjena (Reichspakt) political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: No Revolt
paths.notes: The Polish government sees off its extremist challengers, and remains loyal to its German or Austrian ally.
objectives: Follow the No Revolt political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Socialists - ZSP Radicals
paths.notes:
Chairman Kazimierz Zakrzewski leads the socialist revolution, having been granted Emergency Powers by the Provisional Revolutionary Government.
With the support of the radical wing of the Związek Syndykalistów Polskich, or Union of Polish Syndicalists, he maintains these Emergency Powers for the sake of the revolution, and remains supreme leader.

Note: The socialist revolt can only proceed if the Third Internationale crosses the Rhine, or if Russia is socialist and the Eastern front of the Reichspakt falters.
objectives: Follow the Socialists - ZSP Radicals political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Socialists - ZSP / SZW
paths.notes:
Chairman Kazimierz Zakrzewski leads the socialist revolution, having been granted Emergency Powers by the Provisional Revolutionary Government.
Elections are held after he relinquishes these powers, which are won by either Zakrzewski and his followers in the Związek Syndykalistów Polskich, or Union of Polish Syndicalists, or by their syndicalist and anarchist opposition in the Syndykalistyczny Związek "Wolność", or Syndicalist Union "Freedom".

Note: The socialist revolt can only proceed if the Third Internationale crosses the Rhine, or if Russia is socialist and the Eastern front of the Reichspakt falters.
objectives: Follow the Socialists - ZSP / SZW political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Socialists - PPS-L
paths.notes:
Chairman Kazimierz Zakrzewski leads the socialist revolution, having been granted Emergency Powers by the Provisional Revolutionary Government.
Elections are held after he relinquishes these powers, which are won by the comparatively moderate Polska Partia Socjalistyczna - Lewica, or left wing of the Polish Socialist Party.

Note: The socialist revolt can only proceed if the Third Internationale crosses the Rhine, or if Russia is socialist and the Eastern front of the Reichspakt falters.
objectives: Follow the Socialists - PPS-L political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Nationalists - ON
paths.notes:
Adam Doboszyński, the unlikely successor to the talismanic Roman Dmowski, leads a nationalist uprising against the ruling Polish government. After proving himself in the conflict, and silencing his rivals within the nationalist movement, he and his radically-minded Organizacja Narodowa, or National Organisation, transform Poland utterly.

Requires:
Not any Chjena in The Sejm Elections
Not Socialist Republic in Aftermath of the Assassination
Not RDP - Sulimov in At the Motherland's Helm

Note: The nationalist revolt can only proceed if the Eastern front of the Reichspakt falters.
objectives: Follow the Nationalists - ON political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Nationalists - OZN
paths.notes:
Either through conspiring with the incumbent Chjena government, or by toppling the radical upstart Doboszyński, Edward Rydz-Śmigły and the Obóz Zjednoczenia Narodowego, or Camp of National Unity, seek to invoke Piłsudski's vision, militarise Poland and promote traditional values.

Requires:
Not Socialist Republic in Aftermath of the Assassination
Not RDP - Sulimov in At the Motherland's Helm

Note: The nationalist revolt can only proceed if the Eastern front of the Reichspakt falters.
objectives: Follow the Nationalists - OZN political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Nationalists - Chjena
paths.notes:
After the dangerous fanatic Doboszyński begins a nationalist uprising against the former government, more moderate nationalists from within the Sejm use their influence to bring parliament to their side, and arrest the extremist leader.
The Chrześcijański Związek Jedności Narodowej, or Christian Union of National Unity, also known as Chjena, form a conservative government to lead the uprising.

Requires:
Not any Chjena in The Sejm Elections
Not Socialist Republic in Aftermath of the Assassination
Not RDP - Sulimov in At the Motherland's Helm

Note: The nationalist revolt can only proceed if the Eastern front of the Reichspakt falters.
objectives: Follow the Nationalists - Chjena political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Kaisar-i-Hind
paths.notes:
Utilising the Razakars to execute a self-coup, Osman Ali Khan takes full control of the Federation, dissolves the Council of Princes and leads the Executive Council himself.
After defeating both the Republic and the Dominion, he assumes the title of Kaisar-i-Hind, and is crowned as the nation's emperor.
objectives: Follow the Kaisar-i-Hind political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Father of the Federation
paths.notes:
Utilising the Razakars to execute a self-coup, Osman Ali Khan takes full control of the Federation, dissolves the Council of Princes and leads the Executive Council himself.
After defeating both the Republic and the Dominion, he maintains his position as sole leader of the nation, depicting himself as its first among equals.
objectives: Follow the Father of the Federation political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Triumph of the Razakars
paths.notes:
Utilising the Razakars to execute a self-coup, Osman Ali Khan takes full control of the Federation, dissolves the Council of Princes and leads the Executive Council himself.
After defeating both the Republic and the Dominion, his continued reliance upon the Majlis-e-Ittehadul Muslimeen, or Council for Muslim Unity, also known as the Razakars, leads to them carrying out a coup of their own, with their leader Qasim Razvi installing himself as Diwan at gunpoint.
objectives: Follow the Triumph of the Razakars political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Reign of the Princes
paths.notes:
Hearing of Osman's plan to launch a self-coup against them using the Razakars, the other Princes of the Council send their armies to arrest leading Razakars and confront Osman himself.
In the aftermath, Osman is forced to surrender his powers to the Princes, remaining entirely as a ceremonial figurehead, with the Council of Princes now fully in control.
objectives: Follow the Reign of the Princes political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: The National Government
paths.notes:
Unable to break the conflict between himself and the Council, Osman instead agrees to implement Chetput Iyer's proposal of national elections with a national Diwan appointed by Osman.
While the Andhra Mahasabha emerge the largest party, Osman chooses to appoint Iyer as the Diwan of a National Government, hoping to keep radicalism in check.
objectives: Follow the The National Government political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: The All-India Mahasabha
paths.notes:
Unable to break the conflict between himself and the Council, Osman instead agrees to implement Chetput Iyer's proposal of national elections with a national Diwan appointed by Osman.
In the subsequent elections, Madapati Hanumantha Rao is appointed Diwan and his Andhra Mahasabha, or Andhra Grand Assembly, emerge the largest party, soon renaming the party the All-India Mahasabha, or All-India Grand Assembly.
objectives: Follow the The All-India Mahasabha political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Zhili Monarchy - Pro-Nanjing
paths.notes: During the collapse of the League of Eight Provinces, Wu Peifu's Hexie Shetuan, or Harmony Association, backs the remnants of the League in Nanjing, sending the Qing down a pro-German path.
objectives: Follow the Zhili Monarchy - Pro-Nanjing political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Manchu Coup - Zongshe Party
paths.notes:
Wu Peifu does not intervene in the League collapse, setting in motion a coup against his regime ends in his murder and the re-assertion of Puyi. The Zongshe Dang, or Royalist Party, made up of Manchu aristocracy, leads the new government.

Requires:
Yan Xishan Accepts or Qu Yingguang Accepts or Zhang Tianran in Patron of the Beijing Coup
objectives: Follow the Manchu Coup - Zongshe Party political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Zhili Monarchy - Pro-Anqing
paths.notes: During the collapse of the League of Eight Provinces, Wu Peifu's Hexie Shetuan backs the anti-concessionists in Anqing, sending the Qing down an anti-imperialist route.
objectives: Follow the Zhili Monarchy - Pro-Anqing political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Manchu Coup - YCP
paths.notes:
Wu Peifu does not intervene in the League collapse, setting in motion a coup against his regime ends in his murder and the re-assertion of Puyi. The Zhongguo Qingniandang, or Young China Party, which wants to centralise and urbanise China, leads the new government.

Requires:
Yan Xishan Accepts or Qu Yingguang Accepts in Patron of the Beijing Coup
objectives: Follow the Manchu Coup - YCP political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Manchu Coup - CERA
paths.notes:
Wu Peifu does not intervene in the League collapse, setting in motion a coup against his regime ends in his murder and the re-assertion of Puyi. The Bao Jiu Da Qing Huangdi Hui, or Chinese Empire Reform Association, dedicated to reforming China, leads the new government.

Requires:
Yan Xishan Accepts or Qu Yingguang Accepts or Zhang Tianran in Patron of the Beijing Coup
objectives: Follow the Manchu Coup - CERA political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Manchu Coup - CERA (Reformist)
paths.notes:
Wu Peifu does not intervene in the League collapse, setting in motion a coup against his regime ends in his murder and the re-assertion of Puyi. The combined efforts of Qu Yingguang and the CERA lad to significant reforms, and prepare the country for functioning public elections, with the re-elected Bao Jiu Da Qing Huangdi Hui, or Chinese Empire Reform Association, forming a broader coalition in the future.

Requires:
Qu Yingguang Accepts in Patron of the Beijing Coup
objectives: Follow the Manchu Coup - CERA (Reformist) political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Zhili Republic - Hu Shih
paths.notes:
Wu Peifu does not intervene in the League collapse, setting in motion a coup against his regime ultimately fails, letting him depose the monarchy and re-establish a republic in Beijing, declaring war on the coup's supporters in the process.
The Zhili install eminent philosopher Hu Shih as the first president of the new republic, ruled by the Hexie Shetuan, or Harmony Association.
objectives: Follow the Zhili Republic - Hu Shih political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Zhili Republic - V.K. Wellington Koo
paths.notes:
Wu Peifu does not intervene in the League collapse, setting in motion a coup against his regime ultimately fails, letting him depose the monarchy and re-establish a republic in Beijing, declaring war on the coup's supporters in the process.
The Zhili install renowned statesman Vi Kyuin Wellington Koo as the first president of the new republic, ruled by the Hexie Shetuan, or Harmony Association.
objectives: Follow the Zhili Republic - V.K. Wellington Koo political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: National Bloc
paths.notes: King Amedeo appoints the autocratic Marshal Badoglio. The Marshal consolidates his power and the leads the Blocco Nazionale, or National Bloc, which remains in power if Sardinia is successful in their reclamation.
objectives: Follow the National Bloc political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Rightist Liberals
paths.notes:
King Amedeo appoints the autocratic Marshal Badoglio. The Marshal fails to consolidate power around himself, and the King relieves him of his command, replacing him with Governo Paolo Thaon di Revel.
Thaon di Revel leads Sardinia, which after reclamation thaws into a democracy modelled on pre-1912 Italy, led by the right wing of the Unione Liberale, or Liberal Union.
objectives: Follow the Rightist Liberals political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Leftist Liberals
paths.notes:
King Amedeo appoints the autocratic Marshal Badoglio. The Marshal fails to consolidate power around himself, and the King relieves him of his command, replacing him with Governo Paolo Thaon di Revel.
Thaon di Revel leads Sardinia, which after reclamation thaws into a democracy modelled on pre-1912 Italy, led by the left wing of the Unione Liberale, or Liberal Union.
objectives: Follow the Leftist Liberals political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Democrats
paths.notes:
King Amedeo appoints the apolitical technocrat General Marras. Reformists within Sardinia successfully push for further democratisation, and elections are held.
The Unione Democratica Sarda, or Sardinian Democratic Union, form a centre-right coalition with monarchists, which remains in power if the mainland is restored as Democrazia Cristiana, or Christian Democracy.
objectives: Follow the Democrats political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Liberals
paths.notes:
King Amedeo appoints the apolitical technocrat General Marras. Reformists within Sardinia successfully push for further democratisation, and elections are held.
The Unione Liberale, or Liberal Union, form a centrist coalition with the Democrats. The liberals remain in power as the Partito Liberale Italiano, or Italian Liberal Party, if the mainland is restored.
objectives: Follow the Liberals political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Sardists / National Centre
paths.notes:
King Amedeo appoints the apolitical technocrat General Marras. Reformists within Sardinia successfully push for further democratisation, and elections are held.
The Partito Sardo d'Azione, or Sardinian Action Party, also known as the Sardists, are elected and Camillo Bellieni leads the government.
Moderates within the Sardists split off from the party after the mainland is restored, and the National Centre forms, which remains in power.
objectives: Follow the Sardists / National Centre political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Sardists / Socialist Labour
paths.notes:
King Amedeo appoints the apolitical technocrat General Marras. Reformists within Sardinia successfully push for further democratisation, and elections are held.
The Partito Sardo d'Azione, or Sardinian Action Party, also known as the Sardists, are elected and Giovanni Battista Melis leads the government.
The Sardists split after the mainland is restored and the remnant of the party remains in power, forming the Partito Socialista dei Lavoratori Italiani, or Italian Socialist Labour Party.
objectives: Follow the Sardists / Socialist Labour political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Yiguandao Society

paths.name: Society of Restoring Benevolence
paths.notes: Qu Yingguang and his Guiren Hui, or Society of Restoring Benevolence, ousts Zhang Zongchang and aligns the province with the central government in Beijing.
objectives: Follow the Society of Restoring Benevolence political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Triumph of Yan's Government
paths.notes:
Yan Xishan levies the power of the provincial government, regional gentry, and Jin military clique to purge the insubordinate Guominjun and keep his seat as governor of Shanxi, and the Yan Clique in power.

If any Manchu Coup in Year of the Rat, then Qing must not choose Yan Xishan Accepts in
 Patron of the Beijing Coup
objectives: Follow the Triumph of Yan's Government political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Feng Yuxiang's GMJ Revolution
paths.notes:
Feng Yuxiang assembles a revolutionary coalition of nationalists, socialist radicals, disaffected intellectuals, and others around his populist Guominjun, or National Army, to oust governor Yan from Taiyuan. This leads towards inevitable conflict with the central government.

Requires:
If any Zhili Republic in Year of the Rat, then Qing must not choose Yan Xishan Accepts in Patron of the Beijing Coup

paths.name: Prajadhipok's Reform
paths.ruleGroupName: The Collapse of the Old Order
paths.category: The Collapse of the Old Order
paths.notes: King Prajadhipok finally manages to side-line the Supreme Council of State, and gathers enough momentum for the long-overdue constitution, with the Khanagummakarn Ratsadon, or People's Council, remaining in power until elections are held in a year's time.
objectives: Follow the Prajadhipok's Reform political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Khana Ratsadon Coup
paths.ruleGroupName: The Collapse of the Old Order
paths.category: The Collapse of the Old Order
paths.notes: Amidst the quickly deteriorating economic situation, the Khana Ratsadon, or People's Party, coups the Supreme Council of State. The kingdom's first constitution is reluctantly approved by the king.
objectives: Follow the Khana Ratsadon Coup political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Civil War Averted
paths.notes:
Both sides manage to back down, narrowly avoiding an open conflict.

Requires:
Khana Ratsadon Coup in The Collapse of the Old Order
objectives: Follow the Civil War Averted political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Boworadet Rebellion
paths.notes:
The crisis quickly grows out of control and has engulfs the entire nation in chaos.
Government Parliamentarian forces led by the Khana Ratsadon, or People's Party, are thrust into civil war with Royalist rebels, led by the Khana Gubarn Gumueang, or National Salvation Front, who rise up in the north.

Requires:
Khana Ratsadon Coup in The Collapse of the Old Order
objectives: Follow the Boworadet Rebellion political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Thamrongnawasawat Rebellion
paths.notes:
The crisis quickly grows out of control and has engulfs the entire nation in chaos.
Government Royalist forces led by the Khana Ratsadon, or People's Party, are thrust into civil war with Parliamentarian rebels, led by the Khana Pokpong Prachathipatai, or Democracy Protection Front, who rise up in the south.

Should the rebels be successful, they later form the Khanagummakarn Sapha Patiwat, or Revolutionary Parliamentary Council.

Requires:
Khana Ratsadon Coup in The Collapse of the Old Order
objectives: Follow the Thamrongnawasawat Rebellion political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Coup - Plaek Phibunsongkhram
paths.notes:
Field Marshal Plaek Phibunsongkhram declares himself the head of the new "caretaker" government, after months of martial law being used to suppress both the parliamentarians and the royalists.
Phibunsongkhram successfully passes the Ratthaniyom Decrees, leads the Soi Ratchakhru clique of the Pak Seri Manangkhasila, or Seri Manangkhasila Party, and remains in power.

Requires:
Khana Ratsadon Coup in The Collapse of the Old Order
objectives: Follow the Coup - Plaek Phibunsongkhram political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Coup - Sarit Thanarat
paths.notes:
Field Marshal Plaek Phibunsongkhram declares himself the head of the new "caretaker" government, after months of martial law being used to suppress both the parliamentarians and the royalists.
After his assassination, he is replaced by Sarit Thanarat, who forms the Pak Chart Sangkhom, or Social Nation Party, and promotes extensive powers for the monarchy.

Requires:
Khana Ratsadon Coup in The Collapse of the Old Order
objectives: Follow the Coup - Sarit Thanarat political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Coup - Phao Sriyanond
paths.notes:
Field Marshal Plaek Phibunsongkhram declares himself the head of the new "caretaker" government, after months of martial law being used to suppress both the parliamentarians and the royalists.
After his assassination, he is replaced by Phao Sriyanond, who forms the Pak Chart Thai, or Thai Nation Party, and declares a Republic.

Requires:
Khana Ratsadon Coup in The Collapse of the Old Order
objectives: Follow the Coup - Phao Sriyanond political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Social Action Party
paths.notes:
Spearheaded by the intellectuals, the Pak Kijsangkhom, or Social Action Party, embrace progressive thought for a freer Siam.

Requires:
Prajadhipok's Reform in The Collapse of the Old Order
or Civil War Averted in Siamese Civil War
or the Government is victorious in either Siamese Civil War
objectives: Follow the Social Action Party political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Socialists
paths.notes:
The planned land reform draft by Luang Praditmanutham (Pridi Phanomyong) gives the Siamese people hope of better future, and land the Pak Sangkhomniyom, or Socialist Party, a firm majority.

Requires:
Prajadhipok's Reform in The Collapse of the Old Order
or Civil War Averted in Siamese Civil War
or the Government is victorious against the Bowaradet Rebellion
objectives: Follow the Socialists political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Democrats
paths.notes:
Formed by the royalists, the Pak Prachathipat, or Democrat Party, plan to work very closely with his majesty the king on their new national development schemes.

Requires:
Prajadhipok's Reform in The Collapse of the Old Order
or Civil War Averted in Siamese Civil War
or the Government is victorious against the Thamrongnawasawat Rebellion
objectives: Follow the Democrats political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Accelerated Department - Yang Sen
paths.notes:
Yang Sen's faction of the Sucheng Xi, or Accelerated Department, successfully defends against the Liu Xiang's faction offensive, holding on to power and aiming to bring Sichuan into the Zhili sphere.
Ostensibly the continuity candidate, Yang Sen ensures the continuation of stable governance within Sichuan.

Note: If Wu Peifu is successfully ousted in Beijing, then Zhili remnants take up arms in Sichuan.
objectives: Follow the Accelerated Department - Yang Sen political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Accelerated Department - Liu Xiang
paths.notes: Liu Xiang's faction of the Sucheng Xi, or Accelerated Department, successfully captures Chengdu, routing all opposition. Becoming opportunist and obsessed with high modernisation, Sichuan is transformed into a bastion of progress under Liu Xiang's watch, for the King of Sichuan has far greater ambitions.
objectives: Follow the Accelerated Department - Liu Xiang political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Armament Department
paths.notes:
Yang Sen's faction of the Sucheng Xi, or Accelerated Department, successfully defends against the Liu Xiang's faction offensive, holding on to power and aiming to bring Sichuan into the Zhili sphere.
Ostensibly the continuity candidate, Yang Sen ensures the continuation of stable governance within Sichuan.
Later, Yang's former ally Liu Cunhou and his Wubei Xi, or Armament Department, launches a coup. An opportunist but devoutly loyal to the Jade Marshal, Sichuan is safe under his tenure.

Note: If Wu Peifu is successfully ousted in Beijing, then Zhili remnants take up arms in Sichuan.
objectives: Follow the Armament Department political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Baoding Department - Deng Xihou
paths.notes:
Yang Sen's faction of the Accelerated Department and their allies in the Armament Department collapse under the pressure of Liu Xiang's offensive. In the chaos, the Baoding Department under Deng Xihou asserts control over the capital and successfully lifts Xiang's siege of Chengdu.
Sichuan turns inwards and aims to stay neutral, becoming the cultural hub of rural China, with Deng Xihou leading the Baoding Xi, or Baoding Department, diarchy, leaning the province towards the mainstream Beiyang factions.
objectives: Follow the Baoding Department - Deng Xihou political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Baoding Department - Liu Wenhui
paths.notes:
Yang Sen's faction of the Accelerated Department and their allies in the Armament Department collapse under the pressure of Liu Xiang's offensive. In the chaos, the Baoding Department under Deng Xihou asserts control over the capital and successfully lifts Xiang's siege of Chengdu.
Sichuan turns inwards and aims to stay neutral, becoming the cultural hub of rural China, with Liu Wenhui leading the Baoding Xi, or Baoding Department, diarchy, leaning the province towards the Southern Republican factions.
objectives: Follow the Baoding Department - Liu Wenhui political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Officer Department
paths.notes:
The Armament Department successfully routs Xiang's forces in the siege of Chengdu. The federalist forces of the Jiu Ren Tuan, or Nine Man Regiment, ally with the local Officer Department and the remnants of Liu Xiang's forces, and their combined forces crush the weakened Accelerated Department.
Sichuan becomes a bastion of republicanism, with Li Jiayu's Junguan Xi, or Officer Department, leaning the province towards the Southern Republicans but with major Kuomintang sympathies.
objectives: Follow the Officer Department political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Nine Man Regiment
paths.notes:
The Armament Department successfully routs Xiang's forces in the siege of Chengdu. The federalist forces of the Jiu Ren Tuan, or Nine Man Regiment, ally with the local Officer Department and the remnants of Liu Xiang's forces, and their combined forces crush the weakened Accelerated Department.
Sichuan becomes a bastion of republicanism, with Xiong Kewu's Jiu Ren Tuan, or Nine Man Regiment, leaning the province towards the Federalists but with Left Kuomintang sympathies.
objectives: Follow the Nine Man Regiment political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Zhili Remnants - Yan Huiqing
paths.notes:
The remnants of the Zhili see Yan Huiqing's Beijing Zhixi (Wenguan Pai), or civilian wing of the Zhili Clique, secure themselves within the Marshal's Government.
Intent on reforming sooner rather than later, they seek to analyse the political reasons as to why the Republic failed.

Requires:
Any Manchu Coup in Year of the Rat
objectives: Follow the Zhili Remnants - Yan Huiqing political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Zhili Remnants - Wang Chengbin
paths.notes:
The remnants of the Zhili see Marshal Wang Chengbin's Beijing Zhixi (Junren Pai), or military wing of the Zhili Clique, continue to weather the storm.
Intent on annihilating the despised royalists at any and all cost, the Marshal of Tianjin has a legacy to fulfil.

Requires:
Any Manchu Coup in Year of the Rat
objectives: Follow the Zhili Remnants - Wang Chengbin political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Democracy Eternally Remembered
paths.notes:
Zhang Lan and the Zhongguo Minzhu Tongmeng - Xīn shiji xuehui, or China Democratic League - New Century Research Association, win an upset victory against Xiong Kewu and Dan Maoxin. Their government remains stable.

Sichuan unifies China

paths.name: The Old Dispensation
paths.notes:
Dan Maoxin, Xiong Kewu and the Gonghe Datongmeng - Zizhi Lianhe Hui, or Grand Republican Alliance - United Federal Autonomy Association, win the Federal elections as expected. Their government remains stable.

Sichuan unifies China

Nine Man Regiment in One Province, Four Cliques
Independent in Sichuan Clique Alignment
objectives: Follow the The Old Dispensation political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.notes:
Liberty returns to Ukraine once more as the All-Ukrainian Democratic Movement triumphs over the Hetman's government.

paths.name: Hetmanate - Against Partisanship
paths.notes:
In spite of the chaos of Black Monday and the Anti-Hetman Revolt, the Hetmanate prevails.
Skoropadskyi appoints a cabinet led by the USKhD, which ends up sorely disappointing the Hetman with its lacklustre performance.

The cabinet is later dismissed in favour of one led by the Ukrainska Demokratychna Khliborobska Partiia, or Ukrainian Democratic Agrarian Party. Despite the government's promises towards substantial parliamentary reforms, they are not enough to prevent the Soim remaining secondary to the Hetman, his cabinet and his advisors.
objectives: Follow the Hetmanate - Against Partisanship political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Hetmanate - A Rational Solution
paths.notes:
In spite of the chaos of Black Monday and the Anti-Hetman Revolt, the Hetmanate prevails.
Skoropadskyi appoints a cabinet led by the USKhD, which ends up sorely disappointing the Hetman with its lacklustre performance.

The cabinet is later dismissed in favour of one led by the UDKhP. The new government passes several reforms, and after Russia's defeat the Ukrainska Demokratychna Khliborobska Partiia, or Ukrainian Democratic Agrarian Party, completes the process of parliamentarisation.

Requires:
Russia is defeated in the Second Weltkrieg
objectives: Follow the Hetmanate - A Rational Solution political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Hetmanate - Hetman's Right Hand
paths.notes:

The vast failures of the Soim and the coalition government come to a head, as the authoritarian Soiuz Hetmantsiv Derzhavnykiv, or Union of Hetmanites-State Builders, secures power and further centralises the state.

After Russia's defeat, the screws on power are tightened with Cossack leader Ivan Poltavets-Ostrianytsia turning the Hetman into a virtual puppet of his administration.
objectives: Follow the Hetmanate - Hetman's Right Hand political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

After Russia's defeat, the state relaxes its grip, and Otaman-Minister Borys Homzyn holds new elections which are won by the Hetman's loyalists among the Soiuz Hetmantsiv Derzhavnykiv, or Union of Hetmanites-State Builders.

Danylo Skoropadskyi and Dmytro Doroshenko painstakingly transform the Hetmanate with wide-reaching democratic reforms, and the Ukrainska Radykalno-Demokratychna Partiia, or Ukrainian Radical-Democratic Party come to power in the next elections.

After Russia's defeat, the Ukrainska Sotsial-Demokratychna Robitnycha Partiia, or Ukrainian Social Democratic Workers' Party, win a surprise victory in the post-war elections.

Russia is defeated in the Second Weltkrieg
objectives: Follow the Hetmanate - Red-tinted Hetmanate political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Republic - National Revolution
paths.notes:

However, a brand new crisis threatens the government. After his failure to carry out the land reform, Skoropadskyi's state is swept away by a military coup led by the Legiia Ukrainskykh Natsionalistiv, or League of Ukrainian Nationalists.
objectives: Follow the Republic - National Revolution political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Republic - A Radical Touch
paths.notes:

In the elections following the revolt, the Ukrainska Radykalno-Demokratychna Partiia, or Ukrainian Radical-Democratic Party, forms a government and sets Ukraine on a progressive and parliamentary course.
objectives: Follow the Republic - A Radical Touch political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Republic - Peace and Prosperity
paths.notes:
Liberty returns to Ukraine once more as the All-Ukrainian Democratic Movement triumphs over the Hetman's government.

In the elections following the revolt, the URDP forms a government and sets Ukraine on a progressive and parliamentary course. After Russia's defeat, the party wins re-election, with the right wing of the Ukrainska Radykalno-Demokratychna Partiia, or Ukrainian Radical-Democratic Party, becoming the most influential.

Requires:
Russia is defeated in the Second Weltkrieg
objectives: Follow the Republic - Peace and Prosperity political outcome. Consult the route conditions above before starting.

paths.name: Republic - Revolution from Within
paths.notes:
Liberty returns to Ukraine once more as the All-Ukrainian Democratic Movement triumphs over the Hetman's government.

In the elections following the revolt, the RDS coalesces with the Ukrainian Social Democratic Workers' Party to lay the groundwork for an agrarian and socialist Ukraine.

Should the German defence against the Third Internationale begin to falter, the Robitnycho-Demokratychnyi Soiuz, or Workers'-Democratic Union, complete their transition to socialism and switch sides in the war, joining the Third Internationale once Germany is defeated.

Note: Ukraine switches sides immediately should socialist Russia be at war with Germany. Otherwise, Germany must reach more than 20% surrender progress, and Ukraine must be at war with the Commune of France.

paths.name: Republic - A Fight for the Ages
paths.shortName: Republic - A Fight for the Ages
paths.notes:
Liberty returns to Ukraine once more as the All-Ukrainian Democratic Movement triumphs over the Hetman's government.

But not all is well in the new republic. The inefficiencies of the newly-elected government spell the death of the republican cause as a socialist coup, led by the Ukrainska Partiia Sotsialistiv-Revoliutsioneriv-Borotbystiv (Komunistiv-Syndykalistiv), or Ukrainian Party of Socialist-Revolutionary-Borotbysts (Communists-Syndicalists), violently secures power.

paths.shortName: Zhang Qun and the Genro's New Era
paths.notes:
After the Yunnan Clique seize Guangzhou and form their own rival government, He Yingqin and Dai Jitao initially emerge as its leaders.
However, the growing opposition of the "Old Right" led by Hu Hanmin, particularly over a proposed provisional constitution that formally expands Presidential powers, pushes He Yingqin to attempt to arrest his opponents.
He Yingqin fails, and Zhang Qun and the Guomindang - (Xin) Zhengxue xì, or Kuomintang - (New) Political Science Clique, take advantage of the power vacuum to take power for themselves.
